overall_assessment: The static extraction correctly implements what it claims but is clearly insufficient for semantic-change detection. The negative results are valid and important. The key finding (inversion) is correctly attributed to the limitation of structural features vs. semantic mutations. No P0 issues found.

findings.title: Static control-flow extraction does not build explicit CFG
findings.detail: The ControlGenome uses AST-based McCabe approximation, not an actual control-flow graph. This means loop nesting, dominance, and infeasible paths are not captured. The claim 'CFG similarity' (B03) is also a structure approximation, not a full CFG. A true CFG-based baseline (e.g., using Joern or CodeAnalysis) would be stronger.
findings.fix_notes: ACKNOWLEDGED in Phase 3 gate as P2 limitation. B03 is 'CFG structure approximation.'

findings.title: No inter-procedural analysis
findings.detail: All static extraction is intra-procedural. For programs with multiple functions, call chains and inter-procedural data flow are not captured. SC mutations in helper functions called from main functions may be invisible to single-function extraction.
findings.fix_notes: Known limitation. Affects programs with deep call hierarchies.

findings.title: Error genome relies on exception type names, which may be renamed
findings.detail: ERROR genome captures exception type names (ValueError, RuntimeError, etc.). SP-1 (variable/name renaming) could rename exception types in custom exceptions, causing ERROR distance to increase for semantics-preserving renaming.
findings.fix_notes: Theoretical concern. Custom exceptions are rare in benchmark programs.

findings.title: Bytecode analysis (E4) uses opcode Jaccard, not instruction semantics
findings.detail: E4 bytecode similarity is opcode multiset Jaccard. Two semantically different programs could have identical opcode distributions. Semantic bytecode analysis (symbolic execution, abstract interpretation) would be more rigorous.
findings.fix_notes: E4 documents this as 'approximation' and result shows INVERTED AUROC=0.327.
